import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage

def comps(g):
    g=np.array(g)
    out=[]
    for c in np.unique(g):
        if c==np.bincount(g.ravel()).argmax(): continue
        m=g==c
        lab,n=ndimage.label(m)  # 4-connectivity default

            ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
